title: Master Covers & Overlays (StorylineAndReview)

scenarios.title: Master Covers & Overlays applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Master Covers & Overlays (BtnFlightMode) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Master Covers & Overlays state vocabulary and overlay classification are pinned host-free
scenarios.expected: The persistent tag vocabulary (oPE_FlightMode with ImageCover/Overlay values) is stable; the Light overlay writes 0.95 and the Heavy overlay 0.85 fill transparency, and the classification boundary is inclusive at 0.9, so a freshly written Light overlay reads back as Light and a Heavy one as Heavy.

scenarios.title: Master Covers and Overlays Light overlay enables and disables cleanly in real PowerPoint
scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed Master Covers and Overlays Light overlay bounded overload EnableLightOverlay makes the production GetMode read back LightOverlay (measured modeBefore=None modeAfterEnable=LightOverlay), the bounded Disable restores GetMode to None, both dispatches return true, no new entry appears in the oPenEfficiency error log of the run day, and the host stays stable.

scenarios.title: Master Covers and Overlays Heavy overlay enables and disables cleanly in real PowerPoint
scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed Master Covers and Overlays Heavy overlay bounded overload EnableHeavyOverlay makes the production GetMode read back HeavyOverlay (measured modeBefore=None modeAfterEnable=HeavyOverlay), the bounded Disable restores GetMode to None, both dispatches return true, no new entry appears in the oPenEfficiency error log of the run day, and the host stays stable.
